verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page claim that moving to FreeAgent is straightforward, linking to a switch-to-FreeAgent page. That suggests a first-party migration path but gives no detail on how historical books are imported. The bank-transactions API and statement uploads are developer building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented import or migration of historical ledgers from other accounting systems, evidence that transaction-level detail is preserved, supported source systems and formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
